outcome: Rates of LARC and tubal sterilization during delivery hospitalizations
Factors associated with LARC and sterilization use
cohort: Women who gave birth during 2008-2013 in the United States, identified from the National Inpatient Sample database
finding: While LARC use during delivery hospitalization increased from 2008 to 2013, it remained less than 2% of the sterilization rate, and was more common among women with medical comorbidities, public insurance, and those delivering at urban teaching hospitals.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was associated with a higher likelihood of sterilization.
